no P1; C-1 packet pin (met by Root); C-2 RX gate facts (settings and tablespaces met from P0b and P2, the collation version and properties read by P0c) and the r3 vector (met: unchanged)

residuals: The binding needs the loaded unit settings and drop-in hashes, which P0c reads (D24); GO-P4 waits for a P0c pass
The rollback payload has about 3 KB of headroom with the fixture binding; Root measures it on the real binding before GO-P4
A stop of the staging API slower than 30 seconds ends the switch as an unwind failure that leaves the API stopped; the P3 window stopped it well inside that bound
A host killed between the half-state step and its end line reads as a half state (audit r2 F-3); R4H needs its own owner GO and re-reads the counters
A production restart after the switch blocks the delayed check and the rollbacks before any effect (drift rule)
All tests ran on Windows with a simulated host; systemd, cgroup, journal and file-mode behaviour on Linux are shown only by the earlier accepted host phases
